acc: Where a board source (AnKing card, UWorld, NBME) and a guideline differ, the brief teaches the board answer and puts the guideline in an "In practice:" hover (runbook section 3): the hover is intended, not a finding.
Word counts are not judged (2026-10-19 layers rule: nothing is cut for length).
Hubs (all but bs-tef) stop after Workup and hand off by drawer; treatment by cause sits inside Workup step 4 (s148 hub rule). Steps 5 to 8 absent in a hub is not a finding.
L facts (the old brief's own lines) are a valid source for carried content; judge whether the carried claim is correct for Step 2.

Lead calls (judge accuracy, not the choice): bs-tef teaches feeding with the head elevated (board key) with MSD's prone, 30 to 40 degrees in an In practice hover; infant-stool teaches FPIES reactions as hours later, typically over 2 hours (MSD Food Allergy; no board source gives a range), celiac disease in place of IBD as a brush-border cause (AnKing), and labels the anal fissure row an analogy from an adult card; cyclic-vomiting teaches bouts at about the same time each month (AnKing) with MSD's varying intervals in a hover, and adds cannabinoid hyperemesis (AnKing) with a drawer to substance; peds-constipation keeps anorectal manometry for refractory constipation (live line and bank key) with MSD's abdominal radiograph in a hover, and teaches milk below 24 oz a day; bs-umbilical teaches repair at about age 5 if persistent (UWorld, AnKing) with MSD's elective repair of very large defects after age 2 in a hover, and adds antibiotics to delivery-room care of exposed bowel (AnKing); rlq-pain teaches imaging before surgery for suspected appendicitis (AnKing) and ultrasound first in a child (MSD), with MSD's clinical diagnosis of the classic picture in a hover.

feeding-refusal carries six numbers from the live brief's own lines (L facts) because AAP and CDC pages refused the fetch: iron 1 mg/kg from 4 months, fetal iron stores lasting 4 to 6 months, one new food every 3 to 5 days, finger foods at 8 to 9 months, the 16 oz lower bound of the cow's milk range, reduced-fat milk at age 2. Judge each for Step 2 accuracy and report any you believe a board answer contradicts. It gives no pincer grasp age (AnKing decks disagree: 12 vs 9 months) and teaches vitamin D for any breast milk intake (live line and bank) where MSD says exclusively breastfed: judge both.

Scope calls in the report (not findings): rlq-pain covers the adolescent right lower quadrant (adnexal torsion, appendiceal abscess, ectopic pregnancy by drawer) and, with no live brief owning appendicitis or Crohn disease, scopes out eponymous signs, carcinoid and fecalith cards and gives no Crohn treatment line; feeding-refusal names ARFID with no drawer (no owner) and holds eosinophilic esophagitis treatment in step 4 (no owner).

Items rewritten with a version bump (original stems in place of stems that retold a source vignette; data-src keeps the item's origin): bs-tef q_cc6bbef9bb48 v2, infant-stool q_36b6849a9020 v2, cyclic-vomiting q_1973afbf6f9e v2, rlq-pain q_2084b43af50a v2, q_c4e6b08e6f86 v3, q_a16d32168d82 v3, q_313f717cd948 v2. Judge each as an item.

Lint answered (not findings unless the claim no longer matches its quote): peds-constipation hedge S019 (the card's "may"; the board key makes the laxative the answer; restatement in cuts.json); rlq-pain hedges S001 and S103 ("do not discriminate" carries no hedge); cyclic-vomiting next-step on the factitious row (its action is owned by the Treatment by cause row).
